title: Autobatch Sentinel: Acceptance Harness for Safe Batch/Cache Auto-Apply
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated acceptance harness that validates batching and KV-cache configuration recommendations before they are auto-applied to production routes. The harness (Autobatch Sentinel) will tie cost-optimization proposals to targeted quality regressions measured by lightweight eval suites and a set of curated prompt anchors. If acceptance thresholds are not met, the apply operation must be blocked and an automatic rollback enacted for any staged changes.

Scope:
- Implement an eval runner that executes a parameterized suite of prompts (golden anchors + synthetic edge prompts) against the candidate configuration and the baseline.
- Compute a small set of signal metrics (semantic similarity, answer correctness heuristics, hallucination proxy, safety classifier delta) and a cost delta (tokens/sec, avg tokens/response).
- Define configurable acceptance thresholds per route/model (absolute and relative).
- Integrate with the rollout pipeline: canary -> metric gates -> full rollout or rollback.
- Provide human-readable diagnostic reports and links to failing prompts for on-call triage.

Non-goals: Long-running exhaustive evals, full human labeling in the happy path (we rely on automated proxies with manual followup for ambiguous failures).

Rationale: We observed cost-driven autotune proposals that lowered unit cost but occasionally regressed correctness on low-frequency prompts. A lightweight, targeted acceptance harness reduces developer risk while enabling safe unit-cost wins at scale.

Deliverables:
- Eval harness service + runtime integration with candidate config staging API.
- Default golden anchor set per model family + tooling to author new anchors.
- Dashboarded reports and a CLI action to view failing cases and trigger manual approvals.
- Rollout integration that enforces pass/fail semantics and automates rollback if necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Autobatch Sentinel runs on staged config changes and executes the route-specific eval suite within a 10-minute window
Pass/fail decision based on at most 5 automated signals (semantic sim delta, top-n token overlap, answer-match heuristics, safety classifier delta, cost delta) configurable per route
Default acceptance thresholds defined for all hosted runtime routes; PM can override per-customer on Dedicated/Private
Automatic rollback API invoked when a failed apply reaches canary traffic >10% without manual override
Human-readable diagnostic report generated with failing prompts, metric deltas, and link to PR/commit/confluence
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created. Initial scoping and architecture outline completed. Unblocked if infra quota approved.
2025-02-22: Prototype eval runner implemented (python harness). Can execute 200 prompts across two model variants; measuring semantic-sim via cosine(sim) is cheap and reproducible.
2025-02-27: Backend proposal reviewed by Runtime team — agreed to use staged config objects and a dry-run endpoint to avoid touching live cache state.
2025-03-01: First integration spike with rollout service succeeded in dev; canary gating hook added. Need to define acceptance thresholds with PM/Research.
2025-03-05: Acceptance thresholds drafted; feedback from Linda Cho (PM) and Priya Sen (Research) incorporated. Moving to add dashboard templates and rollback automation.
review_feedback: Linda Cho (PM): Keep default thresholds conservative; safe defaults should prefer no-regression over aggressive cost wins.
Priya Sen (Research): Add an ensemble of cheap proxy signals — single metric failures shouldn't auto-block unless they exceed priority weight.
Diego Alvarez (SRE): Ensure the harness respects runtime resource quotas and has a hard timeout to avoid impacting serving clusters.
Design (Katrina Li): Reports should surface representative prompt outputs (baseline vs candidate) with color-coded diffs for quick triage.
qa_plan: Unit tests for eval runner and metric computations
Integration tests that simulate staged applies including pass and fail scenarios using mocked latency/cost estimators
E2E in a canary namespace with synthetic traffic and seeded failing prompt to verify rollback triggers
Post-deploy smoke that verifies harness runs on daily auto-tuning jobs
next_steps: Finalize default acceptance thresholds with Research and PM (due 2025-03-09)
Complete dashboard template and attach to rollout pipeline
Implement rollback idempotency and alerting for failed auto-applies
Author onboarding doc and create a small set of per-model golden anchors for gpt-style and decoder-only families
